name: jcode
description: Resource-efficient Rust coding agent harness with a fast terminal UI built for running many agent sessions at once.
whatItDoes: jcode is a terminal coding agent focused on low memory use and quick startup. It lets a developer run many sessions or headless workers side by side on one machine. An SDK allows it to be embedded elsewhere.
howItWorks: Sessions share a single background daemon, so each additional agent adds only a few megabytes. The terminal UI attaches to that daemon while headless workers run without a UI. It is installed with a shell script and can update itself.

requirements.name: Model provider account or API key
requirements.description: Access to the model that powers the agent
